title: Messages
body: Use Following for posts from people you follow, or Discover to browse more widely. Reply under a post to keep the discussion together. Direct messages are private conversations.

title: Create a plan from a message
summary: Add dates and tasks to an idea from a discussion.
body: Choose “Turn into a plan” on a message. Review the title, dates and project before saving. Find it afterwards in Plans. The original message keeps its audience.

title: Calendar and Timeline
summary: Choose a date view or a schedule view.
body: Calendar shows events by month, week, day or agenda. Timeline shows plans and project tasks across dates. Switch between them from Calendar.

title: Using @mentions and #topics
summary: Autocomplete and linking for people and topics while writing.
body: Type @ to search people and # to search topics while composing a post, reply, or DM. Choose from the live suggestion list with the keyboard or mouse. Mentions link to profiles and topics link to topic feeds once published.

title: Using slash help
summary: Type / while writing to search support notes and product help.
body: Slash search is for support and help. Type / to search product notes while composing. For example, /@ shows help about mentions, /# shows help about topics, and /support shows general help. This is different from @people and #topics, which insert real handles and topics into the message.

title: Templates
summary: Reuse a set of planning steps.
body: Open Plans to create a template or choose an existing one. Select the event date, check the dates of each step, then create the plan.

title: Post order
body: Following prioritises people you follow, recent posts, bookmarks and reposts from your connections. Discover includes a wider selection.

title: Find help
summary: Search Help or type / in a message.
body: Search this page for a feature or task. While writing a message, type / to find related help.

title: Budgets and receipts
body: Open a project’s Budget to set a limit, allocate amounts and add costs. Record estimates, actual spending and payment status. Attach a receipt image or PDF to a saved cost. Money shows budgets across projects; Payments & IOUs are separate records and are not counted again.

title: Schedule a template
summary: Set the date and preview the steps.
body: Choose a saved template and its event date. Review the scheduled steps before adding the plan. Steps with negative day offsets happen before the event. You can also link the plan to an existing project.

title: Choose who sees a message
summary: Only me, followers, everyone, or project members.
body: Choose an audience before saving or sharing. Only me saves a private note. Followers shares with your followers; Everyone publishes to the public feed. Project members is available when a project is selected. Linking an existing message to a new plan keeps its original audience.
